# Task Center for DSH

**任务中心 / Task Center** — scheduled, HTTP- and hand-triggered tasks for DeepSeek Harness.
Add a task
once, and DSH opens a session or messages an existing one when the task fires.
中文
## A tab, right where you work

Task Center is a tab in the session's right sidebar: no new window, no separate app.
Every row answe

rs three questions at a glance — is it on, when does it fire next, where does it deliver.
A disabled
task stays in the list with its settings and history intact.
## One task, one source
A task is caused by exactly one thing, and every row says which:
- **A schedule** — one-off, fixed interval, daily, weekly, or cron. **Next 5 runs** is computed in t

he time
zone you chose, so a wrong cron expression shows up before you save it.
- **An HTTP request*

* — a webhook URL with its own secret, for CI, a GitHub hook, or a shell one-liner.
- **You** — a ma
nual task has no clock and no address. It runs when you press **Run now**, and at no other time.
Running a scheduled task by hand is still a manual run, and the record says so: *Manual · Session 3f

2a1c*
rather than pretending the schedule fired. The agent can fire one too — `task_center` has a `r
r than pretending the schedule fired. The agent can fire one too — `task_center` has a `run` action.

Deliver into a **brand-new session** or into an **existing conversation**. For a new session the tas
to a **brand-new session** or into an **existing conversation**. For a new session the task decides:

- the **workspace** and the **agent preset**;
- the **model** — the cheap one for routine digests, t

he deep one for real reasoning;
- the **reasoning effort** — off, low, high, max: whatever that mode

l declares. The cheap model at low effort
for a digest, the deep one at max for a refactor that has

to think;
- the **permission** — read only, workspace write, or full access, the same presets DSH it

self offers.
It is in force before the first turn, so a nightly job is boxed in from its very first

The message is yours to write and arrives as a normal user message, so slash commands still work:
`/
goal` turns the trigger into an autonomous goal run, and any `/skill-name` loads that skill.
The model, effort and permission pickers appear only when the Host offers them, and leaving any of t

hem
empty follows the deployment default. The effort list comes from the chosen model, so it can nev

er name
something that model cannot do. If a model or preset later disappears, the task is never sil

ently re-pointed
at something else: the run record says what failed instead of delivering into the w

With `dsh-better-workspaces` installed, a new session can also
land in a **fresh worktree made per r

un**: each run branches off the base you pick, so a nightly job never touches

## HTTP triggers and the run record
An HTTP task gets its own URL and secret, on DSH's own port. The request body replaces `{{payload}}`

in your
message, and **Rotate secret** makes a leaked URL useless in one click.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Every run leaves a record naming its source — schedule, HTTP, or manual: delivered, skipped because

DSH was
closed, or failed because the target was gone. A task that keeps failing is flagged **needs

attention** instead
of quietly doing nothing.
## A preset that hands scheduling to the agent
Installing the plugin adds an agent preset, **任务管理**: Standard mode without the built-in reminder to

ols, plus a
`task_center` tool — so you can say *"every weekday at 9, summarise the repo"* and the a

gent writes the task
itself. It can list, edit, delete, and fire one on demand.
The panel borrows DSH's theme tokens, so it looks native in light and dark alike.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart `dsh web`, open any session, and pick **Task Center** from the right sidebar's start page.
T
he **任务管理** preset shows up in the composer's mode menu.
Behind a reverse proxy, a tunnel, or Cloudflare Access, the panel keeps working: a write is checked

against the
host your browser actually used, not the loopback address DSH bound.
## Uninstall
The plugin writes only under `$DSH_HOME/task-center/` and registers no install scripts, so removing

it leaves no
services, no timers and no patched configuration behind.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Move sessions off the **任务管理** preset first, then click away the one dead tab DSH keeps in your brow

ser.
Details in Uninstall.
